scope: connection test stage A (segmented monitor, attribution, UX, reports, REST)

hypothesis.claim: Probes bound to the Wi-Fi address across router, ISP hop, internet, DNS and web, with outage/spike attribution, locate where a connection fails without ever changing it
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: A probe leaves through another interface, a fault is attributed to the wrong segment, the association changes, or totals do not reconcile

decision.why: Answers 'where does it break' continuously at ~10 kbit/s without servers; owner chose A then B then C

change.summary: Domain model; WindowsConnectionProber (IcmpSendEcho2Ex with source, bound TCP/DNS/HTTPS); WlanAdapter.ReadLinkAsync (+ statistics, RSSI fallback); runner with path discovery (retry, rediscovery), gaps, stop-on-network-change; CONN-ANALYTICS-1; exports; repository schema 4; Connection test mode, drawer, stage, history, CONNECTED badge, linked saturation; /api/connection
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-18: 'agree on A, B, then C'; UX choices; 'build it all'

what_worked: Scripted prober made the runner deterministic
Explicit real run with redacted output found two real-hardware defects
what_failed: SSID change missed when BSSID unchanged (fixed)
Windows TCP reset timing assumption (fixed: Refused without RTT)
ISP discovery intermittent at start-up (fixed: retry + rediscovery)
Driver lacks RSSI opcode (fixed: BSS fallback)
residual_risk: Installed build unverified on the owner's machine
ISP probing depends on provider routers

reuse.reuse_applied: Saturation-test step/hook/drawer/stage pattern; ordered writer; export helpers

lessons.transferable_rule: Run network features once on the real target machine before release; never treat elapsed time as a round trip unless the protocol guarantees one exchange

next_action.action: Owner installs 1.5.0 and runs a 15-minute connection test

scope: connection test stage B (speed and responsiveness)

hypothesis.claim: Multi-stream TCP with ramp exclusion plus latency sampling during load yields capacity and a bufferbloat grade without contaminating monitoring statistics
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Throughput computed from ramp-up, latency under load not sampled, or regular probes running during the test

decision.why: Public providers may publish results with the client IP; owner decision required (DR-0014)

change.summary: RunSpeedTestAsync (pause, idle/loaded latency, grade, RPM≈), SteadyCounter, HttpSpeedClient, responder throughput; schedule and on-demand with confirmation; settings page

residual_risk: Not run against a real server yet

reuse.reuse_applied: Prober latency probes reused for loaded latency

lessons.transferable_rule: Exclude ramp-up from throughput and pause background probes during capacity tests

next_action.action: Owner chooses a stage-B server (LAN responder or own HTTP)

scope: connection test stage C (LAN responder two-way tests)

hypothesis.claim: An authenticated reflector with four timestamps gives per-direction loss, reordering and delay variation without clock synchronisation, safely on a LAN
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Unauthenticated packets answered, replies larger than requests, or clock offset leaking into delay variation

options: Own WSR1 protocol (TWAMP-light style) with HMAC
decision.chosen: Own WSR1 protocol (TWAMP-light style) with HMAC
decision.why: Small, cross-platform, authenticated, no external dependency; covers loss/reorder/variation/capacity
rejected: Full STAMP (more scope than needed now)
iperf3 (external binary, no auth by default)

change.summary: Responder.Core (protocol, server limits), console host, ResponderClient (stream + throughput + Compute), pairing with DPAPI key, portable zip in the release

what_worked: In-process server on loopback tested the real protocol
what_failed: Non-ASCII arrow in console text (fixed, release rebuilt)
residual_risk: Not run over real Wi-Fi against a wired responder

reuse.reuse_applied: E-model and percentile helpers from the analyzer

lessons.transferable_rule: Authenticate every reflected packet and never reply larger than the request

next_action.action: Owner runs the responder on a wired machine and a two-way test
